key_components_and_features.description: Large kinetic hero with line-by-line reveal using framer-motion, live ticker badge showing 'Saved $1.2M+ by Melbourne locals', and a 3D tiltable digital member card preview.

Sticky navigation with backdrop blur (bg-[#FBF8F3]/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-[#E5DEC9]/60), inline SVG logo, links (Deals, How It Works, Submit Deal, Pricing), and 'Join for $49/yr' CTA button.
Slow organic drift marquee built with slow translation showing categories ('CAFES & BRUNCH ★ KIDS ACTIVITIES ★ FINE DINING ★ EVERYDAY ESSENTIALS ★ LOCAL ATTRACTIONS').
Category pills (All, Cafes, Kids, Dining, Essentials, Travel), search input, suburb/location selector, discount badges ('2-for-1', '25% OFF', 'Free Kids Meal'), deal card with image spotlight.
High resolution header image, deal terms, location map badge, business bio, and 'Generate Digital Voucher' button generating unique barcode + QR string with live countdown timer.
AUD $49/year checkout form with tabbed payment options: Credit Card (Stripe inputs), Apple Pay mockup button, Google Pay mockup button, discount code input, and instant active membership activation.

Interactive 3D tilting Member Card (Framer Motion tilt effect on hover/touch) displaying Member Name, Member Code, Active Status badge, Expiry Date, plus tabs for 'My Active Vouchers', 'Savings Calculator', and 'Saved Favorites'.
Form for local business owners to list deals ('Business Name', 'Category', 'Discount Offer', 'Voucher Code Pattern', 'Terms', 'Image URL'). Direct submit to admin queue.
Admin review panel to approve/reject pending business deals, edit existing deal entries, and view membership stats.
Email and Password authentication modal for Member Sign in / Business partner portal sign in.

motion_and_interactions.smooth_scroll: Lenis smooth scrolling integration or smooth CSS scroll behavior
motion_and_interactions.hero_reveal: Staggered line opacity & slide-up animation for main hero heading
motion_and_interactions.member_card_3d: Mouse tilt / perspective 3D transform on digital member card using framer-motion (rotateX, rotateY on mouse move)
motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: Hover scale on deal cards (hover:-translate-y-1 transition-transform duration-200), button active press spring effect, voucher code copy toast via sonner
motion_and_interactions.reduced_motion: Wrap framer-motion with prefers-reduced-motion check or gentle fallback

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive components, buttons, inputs, filter pills, card titles, status badges MUST have explicit kebab-case data-testid attributes.
testing_and_accessibility.wcag_compliance: High contrast ratio (>4.5:1) for text over sand/white backgrounds. Hover states must explicitly set text-white when dark bg is applied.
testing_and_accessibility.aria_labels: Buttons with icons only must include aria-label and data-testid.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the complete frontend application in React using JavaScript (.js / .jsx) inside /app/frontend/src.
Replace the placeholder splash screen in App.js with full multi-page router setup (Landing, Deals, Deal Detail, Checkout, Dashboard, Business Portal, Admin, Auth).
Use Tailwind CSS utility classes aligned with our warm organic palette (#FBF8F3 background, #D95329 primary accent, #F3A72E marigold, #4E7A58 sage).

Ensure all user flows (filtering deals, claiming vouchers, subscribing via Stripe payment mockup, submitting business deals, admin approvals) work seamlessly in-memory and connect with FastAPI backend endpoints where applicable.
Include toast notifications using 'sonner' when claiming vouchers or completing checkout.
Ensure 3D digital member card component features interactive tilt and display of member barcode & QR code.
